description: REGRESSION for DATA-SECURITY-2.md finding #1: the svc{{PERMTESTID}} test user holds only ego.server.admin (not ego.root -- see perm-70/perm-73). ego.server.admin is documented as administration 'without full ego.root', so it must not be usable to grant ego.root to anyone, including yourself. Before the fix, UpdateUserHandler validated a granted permission name only against the list of all known permission names, with no check on whether the caller granting it actually held it -- so this exact request silently succeeded and handed the caller full root.
